title: Machines and Mindful Work
text:
Automation is reshaping the labour market faster than many experts predicted. Routine tasks such as data entry and basic bookkeeping are increasingly handled by software, which allows companies to operate with smaller teams. However, this shift does not necessarily mean fewer jobs overall. Historically, new technologies have created occupations that nobody could have anticipated a generation earlier.

The challenge, therefore, lies less in preventing change than in managing its consequences for individual workers. Employees who regularly update their skills are far better placed to move into roles that demand judgement, creativity and interpersonal care. Governments and employers, many analysts argue, should invest in retraining programmes long before layoffs occur. Otherwise, the benefits of productivity gains may be concentrated among a small group of owners.

questions.text: According to the first paragraph, which tasks are increasingly handled by software?
options: Routine tasks such as data entry

questions.text: According to the second paragraph, what do many analysts argue governments and employers should do?
options: Invest in retraining programmes before layoffs occur

questions.text: What does the author imply about the effects of past technological change?
options: It has often created jobs that were not foreseen
It has always eliminated more jobs than it created
It has had no lasting effect on employment
It was resisted successfully by all workers

questions.text: Why might the benefits of productivity gains be concentrated among a small group, according to the passage?
options: Workers who do not update their skills may be excluded from new roles
Software stops companies from earning any profit
Smaller teams are always less productive than large ones
Governments refuse to fund retraining programmes

vocabulary.definition: changing the form or character of something
regular, predictable tasks that are done the same way each time
results or effects that follow from an action or event
teaching workers new skills so they can do a different job

paragraph_translations: Otomasyon, işgücü piyasasını birçok uzmanın tahmin ettiğinden daha hızlı yeniden şekillendiriyor. Veri girişi ve temel muhasebe gibi rutin görevler giderek yazılım tarafından yapılıyor; bu da şirketlerin daha küçük ekiplerle çalışabilmesini sağlıyor. Ancak bu değişim, genel olarak daha az iş anlamına mutlaka gelmiyor. Tarihsel olarak yeni teknolojiler, bir kuşak önce kimsenin öngöremeyeceği meslekler yaratmıştır.

Bu nedenle asıl zorluk, değişimi engellemekten çok, bunun bireysel çalışanlar üzerindeki sonuçlarını yönetmekte yatıyor. Becerilerini düzenli olarak güncelleyen çalışanlar, yargı, yaratıcılık ve insani ilgi gerektiren rollere geçmek için çok daha iyi konumdadır. Birçok analist, işten çıkarmalar gerçekleşmeden önce hükümetlerin ve işverenlerin yeniden eğitim programlarına yatırım yapması gerektiğini savunuyor. Aksi takdirde, verimlilik kazanımlarının faydaları küçük bir grup sahibin elinde yoğunlaşabilir.
